summary: Drive becomes the drive into the Tape curve, Pre Cut the crossover under the excited band, Amount that band's Amount; Neo Exciter adds the harmonics through oversampled, anti-aliased shapers where Oomek Exciter adds the whole shaped signal.

rules.why: Oomek Exciter divides the sample by 2048 (full scale 32768 is 16) and multiplies by Drive before its shaper, so the shaper sees 16 × Drive for a full-scale input: that gain in dB, 20·log10(16 × Drive), clipped to Neo Exciter's 0 … 36 dB.
Both in Hz: Oomek Exciter high-passes the input at Pre Cut before the shaper; Neo Exciter excites the band above Crossover 3 (Amount 1 – 3 are 0 %).

Amount is the level of the shaped signal added to the dry one, in dB with 0 dB at raw 120; Neo Exciter's Amount is that share of the added harmonics (100 % = 0 dB), so Oomek's +6 dB at the top of the range is held at 100 %.

unmapped.why: Oomek Exciter high-passes the shaped signal again at Post Cut; Neo Exciter adds only the harmonics (the residual after the audio is taken out), so the shaped signal's fundamental, which Post Cut was there to keep out, is not added. A shelf on the harmonics (Shelf freq, Shelf gain) is the nearest control and is left flat.

remarks: Oomek Exciter's shaper is 2x / (1 + 2|x|) at 44.1 kHz with no oversampling, so it aliases; Neo Exciter's Tape curve (tanh) is oversampled 4× with anti-aliasing and adds the odd harmonics only. The harmonic mix differs, the level of the added band is matched.

tolerance.measured: Not measured yet: Oomek Exciter is a native Windows machine and the figures need the Windows package run. Derived from the source (Exciter.cpp: pre high-pass, Drive/2048 into 2x/(1 + 2|x|), post high-pass, times Amount, added to the dry signal).
